parameters: He's a tricky one, \n[8]...\| I wouldn't rest easy until you've killed that man a hundred times.
I am sorry, Nephilim.\! None of the others deserve blame. All of it falls onto me.
I failed to stop you from completing the prophecy.\! Do to me what you must, \n[8].
Just because you didn't succeed...\! Just because you didn't have the physical force to stop me...\! that doesn't make you wrong.
Here, take the Lightfury.\! Strike me down, I will not fight back.
I think I've earned it. You saw what happened, back in Armitage.\! Only you had the guts to stand up to me.\! Now is your chance to put down a monster.
...\| I'd sooner fall on the blade myself...
Look around you. The sky's already changed.\! Everything that's happened has lead to this... the final invasion of Tahnra.\! Indeed perhaps this was all meant to be.

Just as it was written in the forbidden pages, Zanatus has retreated to the Divine Realm beyond the gate at Mount Ptolomea.\! He must be utterly destroyed before he can fully recover.\! Now that \n[8] has claimed Lightfury, the way to the Divine Realm is open.\! So too is the way from there to our world.

Lysander, those who followed him...\| I felt his power. It is beyond description and he is surely not of this world.\! It doesn't matter how we feel about each other... it doesn't matter what happened to get us to this point.\! If we lose, Tahnra will be devoured and in darkness, forever.\! We must be whole, at least... for this one last time.
There is no greater blight to exist than Zanatus...\|I will spend my last lifeblood to fight him.
Thank you...\| Donar be with us.
